name: Money Forward Cloud Invoice
aliases: マネーフォワード クラウド請求書
description: Money Forward Cloud Invoice (マネーフォワード クラウド請求書): partners and their billing departments, items, billings in the qualified invoice format with lines and payment status, quotes with order status and conversion to billings, and the sending history. API v3 with OAuth 2.0 through the Money Forward App Portal.
instructions:
## Money Forward Cloud Invoice
This connector uses the **マネーフォワード クラウド請求書 API v3** (Money Forward Cloud Invoice, `https://invoice.moneyforward.com/api/v3`): your business details, partners (取引先) with their billing departments, items (品目), billings (請求書) in the qualified invoice format, quotes (見積書), payment and order status and the sending history.

Money Forward has separate APIs per product. This connector covers Cloud Invoice only. マネーフォワード クラウド会計 (Accounting: journals, accounts, trial balance) has its own API at `api-accounting.moneyforward.com` and an official MCP server; クラウド請求書Plus, 会計Plus and 債務支払 have their own APIs, partly on request.

**Setup (about 10 minutes)**
1. Sign in to the Money Forward Cloud **アプリポータル (App Portal)** at https://app-portal.moneyforward.com with a user of the business that may manage apps (アプリ連携権限), and register a new app.
2. Enter a name, the redirect URI `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud, or `<your AnythingMCP server URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself, and as **クライアント認証方式 (client authentication)** choose **CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC**.
3. Copy the **Client ID** into `MONEY_FORWARD_CLIENT_ID` and the **Client Secret** into `MONEY_FORWARD_CLIENT_SECRET`, leave `MONEY_FORWARD_REFRESH_TOKEN` empty and install.
4. Click **Authorize with Provider**, sign in to Money Forward and pick the business (事業者). The connector asks for `mfc/invoice/data.read mfc/invoice/data.write`; the authorization belongs to the business, not to one user. Run `money_forward_invoice_get_office` to check.

**Workflow**
- Business: `money_forward_invoice_get_office` (name, address, registration number).
- Partners: `money_forward_invoice_list_partners`, `money_forward_invoice_get_partner`, `money_forward_invoice_create_partner`, `money_forward_invoice_update_partner`. Billings and quotes are addressed to a partner **department** (請求先), not to the partner: `money_forward_invoice_list_partner_departments`, `money_forward_invoice_get_partner_department`, `money_forward_invoice_create_partner_department`, `money_forward_invoice_update_partner_department`.
- Items: `money_forward_invoice_list_items`, `money_forward_invoice_get_item`, `money_forward_invoice_create_item`, `money_forward_invoice_update_item`.
- Billings: `money_forward_invoice_list_billings` (headers and totals, no lines), `money_forward_invoice_get_billing` (full), `money_forward_invoice_create_billing` (draft with lines), `money_forward_invoice_update_billing` (header), `money_forward_invoice_list_billing_items`, `money_forward_invoice_add_billing_item`, `money_forward_invoice_remove_billing_item` for lines, `money_forward_invoice_update_billing_payment_status` to mark paid. Show the partner, lines and total and wait for the user's yes before creating or changing one.
- Quotes: `money_forward_invoice_list_quotes`, `money_forward_invoice_get_quote`, `money_forward_invoice_create_quote`, `money_forward_invoice_update_quote`, `money_forward_invoice_add_quote_item`, `money_forward_invoice_update_quote_order_status`, then `money_forward_invoice_convert_quote_to_billing` when the order comes in.
- History: `money_forward_invoice_list_sent_histories`.
- Sending by email is not part of the API: the documents stay drafts until someone sends them in Money Forward. `money_forward_invoice_post_billing` orders paid postal mailing.

**Reading answers**: lists return `data` and `pagination` (`total_count`, `total_pages`, `current_page`, `per_page`); page with `page` and `per_page` (up to 100). Amounts are JPY and come as strings (`total_price`: "11000"); dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, times ISO 8601 in JST. Ids are opaque strings. `payment_status` reads 未設定, 未入金, 入金済み; `is_locked` true means the billing can no longer be edited. Tax categories (`excise`): ten_percent, eight_percent_as_reduced_tax_rate, eight_percent, five_percent, tax_exemption, non_taxable, untaxable.

**Errors**: 401 means the token expired or was revoked (authorize again); 403 that the app or the user lacks permission or the business is not on a plan with API access; 404 a wrong id; 400 or 422 a validation error whose message names the field (for example a missing `excise` on a line without `item_id`).

**Switched off at install**: `money_forward_invoice_delete_billing`, `money_forward_invoice_delete_quote` and `money_forward_invoice_post_billing`; they cannot be undone (a deletion is final, a posting order sends paper and costs money), so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.
prerequisites: A Money Forward Cloud Invoice (クラウド請求書) business, and an app registered in the Money Forward App Portal by a user with app linkage rights, with the AnythingMCP redirect URI and client authentication CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC.

MONEY_FORWARD_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
MONEY_FORWARD_CLIENT_ID.help: Money Forward App Portal, your app: the Client ID.

MONEY_FORWARD_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client Secret
MONEY_FORWARD_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Same page, the Client Secret. Register the app with client authentication CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC.

MONEY_FORWARD_REFRESH_TOKEN.label: Refresh token
MONEY_FORWARD_REFRESH_TOKEN.help: Leave empty: Authorize with Provider fills it in.

verifyHints.401: Money Forward did not accept the token. Authorize again, and check that the app uses client authentication CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC.
verifyHints.403: The app or the business may not use this: check the app permissions in the App Portal and that the business uses Cloud Invoice.

connector.name: Money Forward Cloud Invoice API v3

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_get_office
tools.description: Read your own business (事業者): id, name, address, phone, office type and the invoice registration number (適格請求書発行事業者登録番号). The install check.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_list_partners
tools.description: List partners (取引先) with id, code, name, kana, memo, their departments (請求先部門, with the id needed for billings) and default payment due date. Filter by name, code, kana or person in charge; several values comma separated.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). pagination.total_pages says how many there are.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_get_partner
tools.description: Read one partner (取引先) with its departments and payment due date setting.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_create_partner
tools.description: Create a partner (取引先) with up to 10 departments (請求先). A billing is addressed to a department, so give at least one with the address and email.

name_suffix.description: Honorific, e.g. 御中 or 様.

departments.description: Up to 10 departments, e.g. [{"person_dept": "経理部", "person_name": "山田 太郎", "email": "keiri@example.co.jp", "zip": "100-0001", "prefecture": "東京都", "address1": "千代田区千代田1-1"}].

office_member_name.description: Your own staff member in charge (自社担当者).

peppol_id.description: Peppol ID for e-invoices, if any.

payment_deadline_setting.description: Default payment due date for this partner (支払期日): {"due_month": "next_month", "due_date": -1, "contingency_day": "move_to_earlier_day"} means end of next month, moved earlier on holidays.

due_date.description: Day of the month; -1 for the last day.

contingency_day.description: When the date is a holiday: move_to_earlier_day, keep_as_is or move_to_later_day.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_update_partner
tools.description: Change a partner (取引先): name, code, kana, honorific, memo or default payment due date. Departments change with money_forward_invoice_update_partner_department.

payment_deadline_setting.description: Default payment due date for this partner (支払期日): {"due_month": "next_month", "due_date": -1, "contingency_day": "move_to_earlier_day"} means end of next month, moved earlier on holidays.

due_date.description: Day of the month; -1 for the last day.

contingency_day.description: When the date is a holiday: move_to_earlier_day, keep_as_is or move_to_later_day.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_list_partner_departments
tools.description: List the departments (請求先部門) of a partner: id, address, contact person, email and CC. The department id is what billings and quotes are addressed to.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_get_partner_department
tools.description: Read one department of a partner with address, contact and email.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_create_partner_department
tools.description: Add a department (請求先) to a partner, e.g. a second billing address or contact.

office_member_name.description: Your own staff member in charge (自社担当者).

peppol_id.description: Peppol ID for e-invoices, if any.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_update_partner_department
tools.description: Change the address, contact or email of a partner department.

office_member_name.description: Your own staff member in charge (自社担当者).

peppol_id.description: Peppol ID for e-invoices, if any.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_list_items
tools.description: List items (品目) with id, name, code, detail, unit, price, quantity and tax category. Filter by name or code; several values comma separated.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). pagination.total_pages says how many there are.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_get_item
tools.description: Read one item (品目) with its code, detail, unit price, unit, quantity and tax category.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_create_item
tools.description: Create an item (品目) with price, unit and tax category, for reuse in billings and quotes.

is_deduct_withholding_tax.description: Withholding tax (源泉徴収) applies to the line. Only for sole proprietors (個人事業主); leave out for corporations.

excise.description: Tax category (税率): ten_percent (10%), eight_percent_as_reduced_tax_rate (reduced 8%), eight_percent, five_percent, tax_exemption (免税), non_taxable (非課税) or untaxable (不課税).

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_update_item
tools.description: Change an item (品目): name, code, detail, unit, price, quantity or tax category.

is_deduct_withholding_tax.description: Withholding tax (源泉徴収) applies to the line. Only for sole proprietors (個人事業主); leave out for corporations.

excise.description: Tax category (税率): ten_percent (10%), eight_percent_as_reduced_tax_rate (reduced 8%), eight_percent, five_percent, tax_exemption (免税), non_taxable (非課税) or untaxable (不課税).

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_list_billings
tools.description: List billings (請求書) with number, title, partner, dates, subtotal, tax, total and payment, email and posting status. Filter a date range (range_key with from and to), or search with q; up to 100 per page. Line items are left out: use money_forward_invoice_get_billing.

range_key.description: Which date from and to apply to: billing_date, due_date, sales_date, created_at or updated_at.

q.description: Free text over partner (exact), status, title and more; when set, the filters below are ignored.

status.description: Status, e.g. 下書き, ロック中, 未ロック.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). pagination.total_pages says how many there are.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_get_billing
tools.description: Read one billing (請求書) with its lines, tax breakdown per rate, totals, statuses, partner and your own registration number.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_create_billing
tools.description: Create a billing (請求書) in the qualified invoice format (インボイス制度対応) for a partner department, with its lines. It is created as a draft and not sent; sending by email happens in Money Forward. Returns the billing with id, number and totals.

department_id.description: Partner department id (請求先) from money_forward_invoice_list_partner_departments or the departments of a partner.

due_date.description: Payment due date (お支払期限), YYYY-MM-DD; from the partner setting when omitted.

billing_number.description: Billing number; numbered automatically when omitted.

payment_condition.description: Payment terms text printed on the invoice (振込先 etc.).

note.description: Remarks (備考) printed on the invoice.

items.description: Lines (明細): [{"name": "Consulting", "price": 100000, "quantity": 1, "unit": "式", "excise": "ten_percent"}] or [{"item_id": "...", "quantity": 2}]. excise is required when no item_id is given.

item_id.description: Item id from money_forward_invoice_list_items; its name is then used.

name.description: Line name (品目名), when no item_id is given.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 個, 時間, 式.

is_deduct_withholding_tax.description: Withholding tax (源泉徴収) applies to the line. Only for sole proprietors (個人事業主); leave out for corporations.

excise.description: Tax category (税率): ten_percent (10%), eight_percent_as_reduced_tax_rate (reduced 8%), eight_percent, five_percent, tax_exemption (免税), non_taxable (非課税) or untaxable (不課税).

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_update_billing
tools.description: Change the header of a billing: department, dates, title, number, payment terms, remarks, memo or tags. Lines change with money_forward_invoice_add_billing_item and money_forward_invoice_remove_billing_item. A locked billing (is_locked) cannot be changed.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_list_billing_items
tools.description: List the lines of a billing with their id, name, quantity, price and tax category.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_add_billing_item
tools.description: Add a line to a billing, from an item (item_id) or written out.

item_id.description: Item id from money_forward_invoice_list_items; its name is then used.

name.description: Line name (品目名), when no item_id is given.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 個, 時間, 式.

is_deduct_withholding_tax.description: Withholding tax (源泉徴収) applies to the line. Only for sole proprietors (個人事業主); leave out for corporations.

excise.description: Tax category (税率): ten_percent (10%), eight_percent_as_reduced_tax_rate (reduced 8%), eight_percent, five_percent, tax_exemption (免税), non_taxable (非課税) or untaxable (不課税).

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_remove_billing_item
tools.description: Remove one line from a billing (the item master stays). Use the line id from money_forward_invoice_list_billing_items.

item_id.description: Line id (billing item id) from money_forward_invoice_list_billing_items.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_update_billing_payment_status
tools.description: Set the payment status (入金ステータス) of a billing: 0 not set, 1 unpaid (未入金), 2 paid (入金済み).

payment_status.description: 0 未設定, 1 未入金, 2 入金済み.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_post_billing
tools.description: Order postal mailing (郵送) of a billing by Money Forward. It is a paid service and sends paper to the partner. Installed switched off.

upload_to_cloud_box.description: true also stores the document in Money Forward クラウドBox.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_delete_billing
tools.description: Delete a billing (請求書) with its lines for good; it cannot be restored. Installed switched off.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes (見積書) with number, title, partner, quote and expiry dates, totals and order status. Filter a date range (range_key with from and to) or search with q.

range_key.description: Which date from and to apply to: quote_date, expired_date, created_at or updated_at.

q.description: Free text; when set, the filters below are ignored.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). pagination.total_pages says how many there are.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_get_quote
tools.description: Read one quote (見積書) with its lines, totals and order status.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_create_quote
tools.description: Create a quote (見積書) for a partner department, with its lines. Created as a draft, not sent.

quote_number.description: Quote number; numbered automatically when omitted.

items.description: Lines (明細): [{"name": "Consulting", "price": 100000, "quantity": 1, "unit": "式", "excise": "ten_percent"}] or [{"item_id": "...", "quantity": 2}]. excise is required when no item_id is given.

item_id.description: Item id from money_forward_invoice_list_items; its name is then used.

name.description: Line name (品目名), when no item_id is given.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 個, 時間, 式.

is_deduct_withholding_tax.description: Withholding tax (源泉徴収) applies to the line. Only for sole proprietors (個人事業主); leave out for corporations.

excise.description: Tax category (税率): ten_percent (10%), eight_percent_as_reduced_tax_rate (reduced 8%), eight_percent, five_percent, tax_exemption (免税), non_taxable (非課税) or untaxable (不課税).

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_update_quote
tools.description: Change the header of a quote: department, dates, title, number, remarks, memo or tags.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_add_quote_item
tools.description: Add a line to a quote, from an item (item_id) or written out.

item_id.description: Item id from money_forward_invoice_list_items; its name is then used.

name.description: Line name (品目名), when no item_id is given.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 個, 時間, 式.

is_deduct_withholding_tax.description: Withholding tax (源泉徴収) applies to the line. Only for sole proprietors (個人事業主); leave out for corporations.

excise.description: Tax category (税率): ten_percent (10%), eight_percent_as_reduced_tax_rate (reduced 8%), eight_percent, five_percent, tax_exemption (免税), non_taxable (非課税) or untaxable (不課税).

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_update_quote_order_status
tools.description: Set the order status (受注ステータス) of a quote: -1 lost (失注), 0 not set, 1 not ordered yet (未受注), 2 ordered (受注済み).

order_status.description: -1 失注, 0 未設定, 1 未受注, 2 受注済み.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_convert_quote_to_billing
tools.description: Create a billing (請求書) from a quote, with the same partner and lines. Returns the new billing; check its dates before sending.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_delete_quote
tools.description: Delete a quote (見積書) with its lines for good; it cannot be restored. Installed switched off.

tools.name: money_forward_invoice_list_sent_histories
tools.description: List the sending history (送付履歴) of billings and quotes: document type and id, from, to, cc, sender and sent time.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). pagination.total_pages says how many there are.
